patient.employment_status: Employed full time as a bartender and event organizer; works nights
patient.social_context: Most friends and co-workers are in nightlife; partner is supportive but concerned
patient.background: Fictional bartender and event organizer who works nights and lives with her partner.
patient.history_summary: Cocaine use that began at work events in 2021 and moved from monthly to most weekends by 2023.
patient.treatment_summary: One assessment visit at a community clinic in 2025. No other treatment contact.

history_events.description: First use at a work event.
Use moves from about once a month to most weekends.
Her partner tells her they are worried about her use.
Attends an assessment visit at a community clinic.
Starts looking at jobs outside nightlife.

factors.description: Late nights in the venue where she works.
Spends a large part of her tips on nights out.
Family history of substance use: unknown.
Partner who raises concerns openly and offers support.
Feels low for a day or two after using.

interventions.reported_outcome: Attended one assessment visit and received information; no follow-up booked.

progress.note: Uses most weekends; unsure whether she wants to change.
Has talked about changing jobs; use continues at weekends.
